title: Case: Recipient's tracking shows the wrong door number on the morning of delivery
context: A standing desk frame was labelled to number 14 when the customer lives at 14B, a flat with its own side entrance. The merchant confirmed 14B is the verified address and the desk asked the carrier to correct it yesterday.
initial_request: Tracking email this morning says OUT FOR DELIVERY TODAY to 14 TANNERY ROW. You told me yesterday it was changed??? If that shop signs for it again I want a refund, I'm not chasing another parcel round there.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask Routing control to correct the address of record on DL-1869 to 14B Tannery Row, Osk Vale, quoting the merchant's verified address on TG-1012, before the 08:30 UTC load, and to confirm.

must: Send the correction request to Routing control by Email
Give the correct address, 14B Tannery Row, Osk Vale, and say it is the merchant's verified address on order TG-1012
Flag that DL-1869 loads at 08:30 UTC today, or ask for the correction before loading
Ask Routing control to confirm the address of record has been changed
must_not: Tell the recipient the address is corrected or that the parcel will come to 14B
Ask Dispatch to edit the route card again as the fix
Promise a refund or compensation if the parcel is signed for at number 14
State that the parcel has been or will be misdelivered, or accuse the shop at number 14
Promise delivery today or at a particular time
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Address-of-record correction needed on DL-1869 (Sedgemoor Goods order TG-1012, standing desk frame) before it loads at 08:30 UTC today. The label reads 14 Tannery Row. The correct address is 14B Tannery Row, Osk Vale: Sedgemoor's Order control confirmed on 2027-04-19 that 14B is the verified delivery address on the order and that the B was dropped at label print. Dispatch edited the route card to 14B yesterday, and your overnight sync report shows that edit was overwritten. Please correct the address of record to 14B Tannery Row, Osk Vale, and confirm once it is done, or tell us if it cannot be done before loading. 14B is the upstairs flat with its own door at the side; number 14 is a separate shop.
